workflow.title: Klinswork Documentation Workflow
workflow.purpose: Define the complete process for turning a completed body of work into a project-aware summary, updated project state, public work-update document, structured sidecar, searchable catalogs, indexed visual artifact, published documentation, and supervisor communication.
designPrinciples: Project context must be loaded before formal documentation is written.
The approved summary.md is the authoritative narrative source for downstream artifacts.
The work narrative must preserve method, chronology, causation, wrong turns, and turning points.
Project state must be reconciled rather than silently overwritten.
Individual sidecars are retained even after they are added to the cumulative catalog.
The public HTML document supports both full reading and a supervisor skim path.
Canonical URLs must be distinguished from temporary, historical, or unresolved URLs.
Generated catalogs and manifests must be validated against their source records.
Instruction sets should be loaded at the workflow stage where they are needed.
Missing project records or roadmaps must be acknowledged rather than invented.

workflowStates.description: Active building, testing, troubleshooting, discussion, and decision-making.
Active work has paused and a defined body of work is ready to be preserved.
The primary project, related projects, and available project state have been identified.
summary.md is being reconstructed and refined.
The authoritative work summary has passed human and model review.
The project delta and revised roadmap have been determined.
The work-update HTML and individual sidecar have been created.
The summary, HTML, sidecar, anchors, and structured records have passed validation.
The individual sidecar has been aggregated and catalog metadata regenerated.
The work-update image has been generated, saved, and added to the image manifest.
Artifacts have been committed, pushed, and made available through canonical URLs.
Publication, indexing, communication, and final verification are complete.

instructionSets.purpose: Switch from performing work to preserving and interpreting it.
Guide creation of the project-aware narrative source summary.
Reconcile the approved summary against the prior project state and roadmap.
Generate the public HTML document and supervisor reading path.
Describe the finished HTML document in structured form.
Generate the visual artifact from approved publication material.
Publish artifacts, record canonical URLs, and rebuild the documentation index.
Send the update, verify all outputs, and close the documentation cycle.

phases.title: Perform and Close the Work Session
Create and Index the Visual Artifact

steps.title: Perform the work
steps.purpose: Complete the actual building, testing, troubleshooting, discussion, and decision-making.
actions: make and record decisions in the conversation
collect screenshots, logs, outputs, and deployment evidence
validation: The work has reached a meaningful stopping point before documentation begins.

steps.title: Declare a documentation checkpoint
steps.purpose: Define the body of work that is ready to be preserved.
actions: identify where the documented work begins and ends
classify the coverage as a session, milestone, phase, release, or complete build
identify unfinished work outside the documentation boundary
validation: The body of work is bounded clearly enough to summarize.
Unfinished work is not falsely presented as completed.

steps.title: Load the documentation-checkpoint instruction set
steps.purpose: Load the procedural context for the documentation cycle.
actions: identify required evidence and expected outputs
validation: The instruction set identifies the current stage, required inputs, outputs, and next stage.

steps.title: Identify the primary and related projects
steps.purpose: Place the work into its durable project context.
inputs: affected apps, components, and shared data
actions: identify the parent project or umbrella program
distinguish projects from apps, releases, components, and shared foundations
record confidence and evidence for each classification
validation: A project is not inferred merely because it is mentioned.
Primary and related projects are distinguished.
Provisional classifications are labeled.

steps.title: Load the available project context
steps.purpose: Establish the project's durable goal, previous state, roadmap, and recent history.
actions: load related project context only when materially relevant
reconstruct context cautiously when records do not yet exist
validation: Missing project records are acknowledged.
Missing roadmap items are not invented.
Related project context is loaded only when useful.

steps.title: Load summary-md-template.json
steps.purpose: Load the reasoning and writing instructions for creating summary.md.
validation: The template is valid JSON.
The template identifies required context, ordered sections, and quality checks.

steps.title: Construct and refine summary.md
steps.purpose: Create the authoritative narrative source for the documented body of work.
actions: establish the situation before the work
preserve the narrative, method, chronology, and causation
draft project delta and revised roadmap
validation: The summary preserves how the result was reached.
The summary distinguishes completed, partial, planned, and unverified work.
The summary contains enough information for downstream artifacts.

steps.title: Review and approve the summary
steps.purpose: Confirm that summary.md is accurate, complete, useful, and ready to become the source for downstream artifacts.
actions: restore missing steps and turning points
validation: All applicable summary quality checks pass.
The user approves the summary as the authoritative source.

steps.title: Derive the project delta
steps.purpose: Calculate how the documented work changed the project and roadmap.
actions: classify prior items as completed, partial, still open, deferred, or superseded
create the revised ordered next-step list
validation: Prior state is preserved.
No prior roadmap item disappears without classification.
Newly inferred work is labeled appropriately.

steps.title: Update the project records while preserving history
steps.purpose: Integrate the project delta into the durable project records.
actions: preserve completed, deferred, and superseded history
link the summary and future work update
validation: Earlier state is not silently overwritten.
The updated roadmap agrees with the approved summary.
Missing project-record infrastructure is recorded as pending.

steps.title: Generate the work-update HTML document
steps.purpose: Create the public document from the approved summary.
actions: generate the complete narrative and technical document
add a gold Supervisor Brief near the beginning
add pointing-hand links to the next supervisor note
add stable anchors and accessible labels
validation: The HTML is valid and readable.
Supervisor callouts are visually and semantically distinct.
The full document remains available outside the skim path.

steps.title: Generate and retain the individual document sidecar
steps.purpose: Create a structured description that allows rapid understanding of the finished HTML document.
actions: record project context represented in the document
record narrative structure and project contribution
record communications, graphics, publication, deployment, and provenance
validation: The sidecar is valid JSON.
The sidecar accurately describes the finished HTML.
The sidecar does not replace the project record or workflow run record.

steps.title: Validate the summary, HTML, and sidecar
steps.purpose: Catch structural, linkage, schema, and publication errors before indexing.
actions: check supervisor callout order and next-note links
validate sidecar JSON and schema version
compare the sidecar with the HTML
check alt text and publication descriptions
validation: All blocking validation errors are resolved.
Narrative and project interpretation have received human or model review.

steps.title: Append the individual sidecar to the cumulative catalog
steps.purpose: Add the new document record to the searchable aggregate.
validation: The sidecar appears exactly once.
No unrelated record is altered.
The individual sidecar remains available.

steps.title: Regenerate catalog metadata and validate the catalog
steps.purpose: Recalculate catalog summaries and verify aggregate consistency.
actions: recalculate projects, document types, applications, topics, and versions
rebuild document ID and title lists
validation: Entry counts agree.
Every expected sidecar appears exactly once.
Metadata and catalog fields are internally consistent.

steps.title: Generate the work-update image
steps.purpose: Create a visual artifact representing the significance of the documented work.
validation: The image represents the documented significance rather than an incidental screenshot.
The image has appropriate alt text.
The image follows the intended publication format.

steps.title: Save and index the image
steps.purpose: Store the image and update the image repository manifest.
actions: save the image in the repository
record the document and project relationship
validation: The image file exists at the expected path.
The manifest contains the image exactly once.
The manifest includes description, alt text, and document relationship.

steps.title: Commit, push, and record canonical URLs
steps.purpose: Publish the coordinated artifacts and establish their canonical resource locations.
actions: record the GitHub Pages document URL
update the sidecar and catalogs when post-publication URLs become available
validation: Public resources are accessible where expected.
Temporary runtime URLs are not recorded as canonical.
Post-publication sidecar changes are reflected in regenerated catalogs.

steps.title: Regenerate and publish the canonical documentation index
steps.purpose: Update the scriptable public index from the structured catalog.
actions: verify the new work update appears
retain Google Sites as a portal or curated presentation surface when useful
update Google Sites manually only for selected or structural changes
validation: The new update appears in the canonical index.
Project, date, topic, and link information resolve correctly.
The hosting choice is recorded.

steps.title: Send the update and complete the documentation run
steps.purpose: Communicate the update, verify all required outputs, and formally close the documentation cycle.
actions: load the approved email subject and body
send the update to intended recipients
verify catalogs and manifests are current
verify the public document and index are accessible
validation: All required artifacts exist or missing artifacts are explicitly recorded.
The communication has been sent or intentionally deferred.
The documentation run has a clear final status.

blockingConditions: work-update HTML is missing or structurally invalid
image manifest references a missing image
a temporary Apps Script URL is presented as canonical
nonBlockingConditions: project-record infrastructure does not yet exist
a related project record is unavailable
a canonical URL is not yet available before publication
Google Sites has not been manually updated
a knowledge-base candidate has not yet been promoted
